page_text:
May 9, 2019 

Denise McNerney 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:   No. 17-1618, Bostock v. Clayton County 
No. 17-1623, Altitude Express v. Zarda 
No. 18-107, R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes v. EEOC, et al. 

Dear Denise: 

In response to your email on Monday, I am pleased to say that counsel for all the 

parties in the three cases have conferred, and we propose the following schedule for 
briefing.  We hope the Court can enter an order to this effect, especially so that counsel 
for potential amici will have notice. 

Petitioners’ (plaintiffs) briefs would be due Wednesday, June 26 

Amicus briefs supporting petitioners would be due Wednesday, July 3 

Respondents’ briefs and the brief for the United States in No. 18-107 would be 

due Friday, August 16 

Amicus briefs supporting respondents would be due Friday, August 23 

Petitioners’ reply briefs would be due Monday, September 16 

Please let me know if you have any questions. And thanks for all your help in 

moving this process forward. 

Sincerely, 

Pamela S. Karlan 

Cc: All counsel
